soa_notes.text: This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-NP01 (NP01) for LY3016859. Please refer to master protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (CPMP) and the diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain (DPNP) disease-state addendum (DSA) H0P-MC-CPMP(3) SoAs for additional information.
